verses.1: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy, his brother.
verses.2: To the holy and faithful brothers in Christ who are in Colossae: May God, our Father, grant you grace and peace.
verses.3: We give thanks to the God, our Father, for our Lord Jesus Christ. We pray for you always.
verses.4: Hearing the faith that you have in Christ Jesus, and the love that you have for all the saints.
verses.5: Because of the hope that has been given to you in heaven, the hope that you anticipated in the message of the truth of the gospel.
verses.6: As it is with you now, just as it is in the entire world, things are growing and expanding, just as they do among you. From days ago, you have heard and understood this as a gift from God.
verses.7: As you have learned from Epaphras, our beloved servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ.
verses.8: He also revealed to us your love in the spirit.
verses.9: For this reason, we, who have heard these words over the course of many days, will not cease to pray and ask for your help, so that you may fulfill his desire in every wise and spiritual way.
verses.10: To walk humbly before the Lord with all due respect in every good and beneficial task, and to increase our knowledge of God.
verses.11: With all their strength, they act in accordance with the glory of that kingdom, with patience and longsuffness, and with joy.
verses.12: Thanking the Father, we hope that you will be granted a share in the inheritance of the saints in light.
verses.13: Who has rescued us from the power of darkness and made us heirs to the kingdom of his beloved Son.
verses.14: In whom we have the forgiveness of sins, the elimination of our transgressions.
verses.15: What is the image of the God of the heavens? He is the creator of all creation.
verses.16: For in him were contained all things in the heavens and on the earth: both the visible and the invisible, whether it be thrones, dominations, authorities, or powers. All things will be revealed through him, and to him all things return.
verses.17: And he is the one in whom everything is arranged and organized.
verses.18: And he is also the head of the body of the church. He is the beginning, the firstborn among the dead, so that he may become the leader over all others.
verses.19: Because everything about it was pleasing to live in.
verses.20: And through him, everything can be arranged in harmony. By the blood of his cross, everything on earth and in heaven can be made peaceful.
verses.21: And you, who are sometimes treated as worthless and hated by those who work evil deeds—
verses.22: But now, the flesh of his body does not decay due to death. Thus, you will appear to be holy, pure, and blameless before him.
verses.23: If you truly adhere to the faith that is firm and steadfast, and do not waver from the hope of the gospel that you have heard, which was proclaimed in every place under heaven by me, Paul, your minister.
verses.24: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you. I also make up for the hardships caused by Christ’s death in my body, so that his body may be glorified. This is the Church.
verses.25: I became your servant in order to carry out God’s commandment, that is, to fulfill the word of God for you.
verses.26: The mystery that has been hidden from all ages and generations—now has been revealed to the holy ones.
verses.27: So that the Lord might know what would be the benefit of this mystery’s fame among people. That is Christ among you; it is the hope of that fame.
verses.28: We must warn everyone against being deceived by anyone, and we must teach everyone in every aspect of wisdom, so that we can present everyone as perfect people in Christ.
verses.29: And I will also fight against him, in accordance with his actions, which are harmful to me.
